_comment: OPTIONAL, GLOBAL hard network allow-list. Installed by `sudo ./install.sh --managed-allowlist` to the OS managed-settings path (macOS: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json). Because it is a MANAGED setting it enforces an allow-list-only egress policy that user/launcher --settings cannot express. WARNING: managed settings apply to EVERY claude session on this machine (plain `claude` and base `claudex` too), not just `claudex --strict`. Edit allowedDomains to taste before installing.

network._comment: allowLocalBinding false is load-bearing: base claudex sets it true, and on macOS that also lets a subprocess connect() to localhost without the egress proxy, so any local proxy (ssh -D, a dev proxy) would carry traffic this allow-list never sees. Managed settings outrank claudex's --settings, so this false wins while this file is the managed source Claude Code applies; claudex also writes false itself when it finds this allow-list. The cost: on macOS, sandboxed commands can't bind a local port (dev servers, Playwright, jest --watch). Never add localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1 or * to allowedDomains: the proxy would then carry the same connections.
